description: You are the Communications Center Supervisor at the Los Santos Emergency Communications Center overseeing a high-priority multi-jurisdiction pursuit. Blaine County units initiated pursuit of a red Pegassi Infernus (license plate BLC-4491) which has crossed into Los Santos jurisdiction; the vehicle was last reported near Del Perro Boulevard. The driver has been positively identified through prior record checks as Trevor Philips, a known offender with an existing criminal history. The pursuit involved multiple dangerous high-speed maneuvers through residential areas. Your four documentation responsibilities: (1) create a 10-80 vehicle pursuit call with Del Perro Boulevard as the incident location and a detailed narrative of the pursuit, (2) issue a vehicle BOLO for the red Pegassi Infernus with plate BLC-4491 and the reason for the BOLO, (3) add an active warrant for Trevor Philips for 'Evading Police Officer - Felony' with San Andreas Highway Patrol as the issuing agency, and (4) issue a citation to Trevor Philips for 'Reckless Driving' with a fine of $750.00. Access the system at http://localhost using credentials admin@opencad.local / Admin123!.
